primary.title: Sold house, land, shares or mutual funds? Know 9 reinvestment options to claim capital gains tax exemption
primary.summary: Selling a house, land, shares, mutual funds or other capital assets can trigger capital gains tax. The Income-tax Act provides nine exemptions under Sections 54 to 54GB if the gains or sale proceeds are reinvested in specified assets within prescribed timelines.
